summary: Off-registry unpinned git dependency resolved at install time
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` as `git+https://github.com/whiskeysockets/libsignal-node` — a bare git URL pointing at the repository's default branch with no version tag, no commit SHA, and no integrity constraint. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever the default branch currently contains and installs it, executing any lifecycle scripts inside that source tree. The bytes fetched are not pinned and not integrity-checked, so control of that upstream repository (or of a mutable ref within it) equates to code execution on the installer's machine at install time. The package is a Baileys-family WhatsApp library fork; the ping/GET pattern in lib/Utils/generics.js is consistent with the normal Baileys keep-alive/HTTP-request helper and is not itself exfiltration, but the off-registry git dependency is sufficient on its own as an install-time code-inclusion vector (CWE-829).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
